body: AURIC ULVIN, the farm boy and escaped prisoner who came out of the frozen mountain as lord of the lost men, leader of the Illians in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; man; about twenty; lean and hardened. Frost-pale skin, untidy white-blond hair, ice-blue eyes too still and old for his young face, a farm boy's chapped knuckles.
costume: a white wolf-fur cloak over a pale sky-blue robe edged in silver, frayed prisoner's rags still knotted at his wrists.
signature: A jagged CROWN OF CLEAR BLUE ICE always rises from his brow.
extra: Cold follows him: his breath shows white, and frost creeps over whatever he touches.

vibes.name: Becoming God
vibes.line: His right hand raised before his face, turning as he watches frost climb from the fingertips up his wrist, his left fist closed on ears of wheat freezing white, lips parted; one eye still blue, one gone white; the dead god's ruined ice temple under a green aurora at night.
vibes.wears: a farm boy's patched brown homespun shirt and sheepskin jerkin, the left half already crusted white with ice and hung with icicles.

vibes.name: Kept Secret
vibes.line: Looking over his shoulder at the viewer with a faint closed smile, his right hand drawing a curtain across the archway behind him, his left tucking something small inside his robe; cold white light spilling past, his face in blue shadow; deep in the frozen mountain on the third morning.
vibes.wears: a long robe of ancient Illian silk, ivory gone faintly blue with age, embroidered with faded silver glyphs, the deep hood fallen back.

vibes.name: Endless Winter
vibes.line: His arms spread wide, both fists clenched hard, dragging the blizzard down onto the land, chin raised, face calm and unsmiling, eyes lifted to the white sky as the storm answers him; a high ridge at midday, the world white to every horizon, flat glaring snow-light.
vibes.wears: armour of overlapping pale blue ice-like scales over grey mail, a long storm-grey cloak torn ragged by the wind, a silver gorget.

vibes.name: Prisoner's Rags
vibes.line: His left fist clenched while his right hand winds a frayed strip of prison rag around that wrist and knots it like a vow, jaw set, eyes level and hard on the viewer; an empty prison cell, its iron door hanging open and frosted, grey evening light through the bars.
vibes.wears: a lord's long robe of midnight-blue velvet edged in silver, and below its cuffs the frayed grey prison rags he still keeps knotted at both wrists.
